reason: Verified that the agent can successfully open a browser, navigate to https://example.com, retrieve the page title "Example Domain", and report it back.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully with Gamut agent interface and agent list in sidebar.
Clicked on "QA-20260929-204757-9cxg" agent in the sidebar — Agent page opened and displayed the agent's chat interface with empty message history.
Typed message "Open a browser and go to https://example.com. Tell me the page title." in the input field — Message was successfully entered in the textbox.
Clicked the Send message button — Message was sent to the agent, and a new session "Browser Navigation and Page Title Check" was created with the agent status changing to "working".
Waited up to 3 minutes for the agent response — Agent completed the task in 14 seconds and returned the response mentioning "Example Domain".
Took a screenshot to verify the response — Screenshot confirms the agent successfully reported the page title as "Example Domain" and that the response message is clearly visible in the chat.
